chunks: “He will be placed in a spot in Hell to which the intensity of the punishment of its inhabitants reaches. If he had killed all the people, he would only enter that very place.”
It was said: “Then if he killed another?” He said: “It will be doubled upon him.”

key_terms.شِدَّةُ عَذَابِ أَهْلِهَا: The utmost severity of punishment endured by the inhabitants of that place.
key_terms.مَوْضِعٍ مِنْ جَهَنَّمَ: A specific place in Hell assigned for punishment.
key_terms.يُضَاعَفُ عَلَيْهِ: The punishment is increased and multiplied upon him.
key_terms.يُوضَعُ: He is placed or assigned there.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the punishment for murder in Hell?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the grave punishment in Hell for unlawful killing, indicating that the murderer is placed in a station of extreme torment. It also states that repeated killing increases the punishment, underscoring the enormity of shedding protected blood.
